description.reference: G15-direct-g0-mix (configs/G15-MIX-RESEARCH-FROZEN-v1.json, D145): the frozen MPS flatten direct head of seed s (EXP-P15-001 seeds 0-2, EXP-P16-001 seeds 3-4) mixed 1/2 with the frozen G0-global member of seed s (Cpanel EXP-P4-001 seeds 0-2 and EXP-P10-001 seeds 3-4; whole MLB EXP-P11-001), five-seed mean, June frequency blend selected on the Cpanel June (blend) rows; whole MLB blended with the EXP-P11-001 frequency baseline using the Cpanel June weights (ensemble and per seed), exactly as run_ml_direct_head_confirm.score_arrays
description.integrity: every frozen input is anchored to a pinned chain before any array is read (rules.inputs.anchors, uniform): the G15 config, the G0 bundle it pins and the recorded EXP-P16-001 results against rules.reference; frequency baselines and G0-global Cpanel member states against the G0 bundle listing; flatten member states against the G15 listing; whole-MLB G0-global member states AND archives against the EXP-P11-001 analysis manifest whose sha256 the G0 bundle pins (bundle -> manifest sha -> manifest inputs -> member state -> artifact hashes). A file listed in more than one pinned map must agree with every one; any missing or differing link fails closed. Each member npz is also checked against its adjacent *_state.json artifact_hashes and member model hashes against the frozen member records
description.alignment: CUDA archives must carry exactly the Mac baseline rows (EXP-P4-001 blend/dev, EXP-P11-001 mlb_dev; keys, labels, game ids, pitcher ids) with the no-physics marker; a different row order is aligned by the 3-column pitch key with a recorded permutation; any missing or extra key fails closed
description.reproduction_gate: before any candidate is scored, the recomputed G15 Cpanel-after-blend NLL and whole-MLB-blended NLL, the G0-global values of the same rows and the five per-seed G15 - G0 deltas of both splits must equal results/EXP-P16-001.json within 1e-9; otherwise abort with nothing scored (the aggregate NLL alone is invariant to swapping members between seeds)
description.candidates: for each CUDA arm (control, periodic_residual_counts, tabm_residual_counts) two mix rules, then the June frequency blend as usual: MIX_FIXED (weight 1/2 for every seed and the ensemble, identical to the G15 rule; isolates the head) and MIX_FIT (per seed w on the June blend split only, minimizing the pitch-weighted NLL of w*head + (1-w)*G0 over the grid 0.50, 0.55, ..., 0.95, ties to the smaller w; the ensemble weight chosen the same way on the seed-mean head and seed-mean G0). control at MIX_FIXED measures the pipeline difference (cap 60 CUDA vs cap 30 MPS flatten, same mix); both control rows are descriptive and have no N decision
description.comparisons: candidate minus G15 by matrix_metrics.paired_game_comparison (10,000 whole-game draws, seed 20260924) on (i) Cpanel DEV after the June blend and (ii) whole-MLB DEV blended; per-seed deltas against the G15 member of the same seed
description.N_rule: matrix_metrics.prediction_decision, stage final: ensemble delta NLL <= -0.003, paired 95% CI upper < 0, one-sided p <= .05 (the primary with its own unadjusted p; the secondary rows with the Holm-adjusted p across the three secondary rows of the split), Brier CI upper <= 0.001, at least 4 of 5 seeds improving
description.multiplicity: exactly one confirmatory test: the prespecified primary tabm_residual_counts MIX_FIT, confirmed only by intersection-union, i.e. a predictive_improvement on BOTH splits, each judged with its own unadjusted one-sided test at alpha .05 (no Holm for a single prespecified test). The three other candidate rows (periodic_residual_counts x MIX_FIXED and MIX_FIT, tabm_residual_counts MIX_FIXED) are secondary / exploratory: per split, Holm across those three as a descriptive adjustment; a combined both-split secondary outcome is labelled exploratory, never confirmed. Control rows and the unblended head rows have no N decision
description.primary_candidate: tabm_residual_counts MIX_FIT (pre-specified): the only row that can be confirmed; every other candidate row is secondary / exploratory, control rows are descriptive
description.pipeline_comparison: the CUDA heads of this family train with the epoch cap 60 on CUDA, while the G15 flatten heads were fitted with the cap 30 on MPS (configs/EXP-P16-001.yaml unchanged_from_g0.training), so every candidate - G15 row compares two pipelines, not two architectures; the control MIX_FIXED row (same flatten architecture, same 1/2 mix) measures that pipeline difference directly
descriptive: unblended calibrated five-seed head (no G0 mix, no June blend) vs the G15 flatten head on Cpanel DEV and whole-MLB DEV
MIX_FIT weights per seed and ensemble with the June-blend NLL of every grid weight
Brier and ECE10 of every row
